meta.title: Media Library Export Import demo
meta.description: Installs the latest release with a few sample images and opens Media → Export / Import.
meta.author: mkrndmane

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php'; wp_set_current_user( 1 ); foreach ( array( '', '', '' ) as $i => $png ) { $n = $i + 1; $tmp = wp_tempnam( 'sample-' . $n . '.png' ); file_put_contents( $tmp, base64_decode( $png ) ); $id = media_handle_sideload( array( 'name' => 'sample-' . $n . '.png', 'tmp_name' => $tmp ), 0, 'Sample image ' . $n ); if ( is_wp_error( $id ) ) { throw new Exception( $id->get_error_message() ); } update_post_meta( $id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', 'Sample alt text ' . $n ); }
